summary: I18n context provider and hooks for the Endfield site. Holds a hard-coded JSON table of 33 operators (key, codename, camp, race, rarity, prof, elem) and three CDN image maps (avatar, illust, portrait) served from https://web-static.hg-cdn.com/endfield/official-v4/_next/static/media/<key>.<hash>.png; the available language list comes from SiteConfig.i18n (first entry is the default lang) and a display-name table maps codes such as en-us, zh-cn, ja-jp to native names. useI18n reads the context {lang, langs, images, text, font, data, components}; useText returns t(key) which first tries a flat key then walks dotted paths (e.g. 'operator.content.<key>.name'); useOperators memoizes operator records merging the table, images and localized name/intro/camp/race plus cv voice actors for zh-cn, ja-jp, ko-kr and en-us.
